title: SSAO in compatibility renderer in VR works for ~3 minutes then "wigs out"
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot 4.6.3, 4.7.1 and `master` (45a98064e977c70caf44b6abd1c9717d0ea736f6)

### System information

Meta Quest 3 and Samsung Galaxy XR

### Issue description

With SSAO enabled in the compatibility renderer in VR, everything works great for about ~3 minutes, and then rendering increasing "wigs out":

1. There will be a transparent overlay of the edges of objects in the scene, that is somewhat offset from the objects
2. The visuals will start to increasingly jitter
3. The camera will appear to jump between two different locations every couple frames (with the number of frames between getting less and less)

**Watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tEkchVXk3JM) of it wigging out!**

I've been able to reproduce this on:

- Meta Quest 3
- Samsung Galaxy XR

### Steps to reproduce

I've been testing this with [Museum of All Things](https://github.com/m4ym4y/museum-of-all-things) on [this commit](https://github.com/m4ym4y/museum-of-all-things/commit/1ceb5ec5f58544fbd2a3f14cbf4bf94673ede990)

If you open the project in Godot 4.6 or later (which includes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/109447) and play for ~3 minutes, it will happen without fail :-)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I don't have one - for now, there's [Museum of All Things](https://github.com/m4ym4y/museum-of-all-things)
